relationships.evidence_quote: levels of the primary mediators of inflammation PGE-2 and 5-LOX, as well as malondialdehyde (MDA), a marker of oxidative stress, were significantly lower in the treated rats

key_findings: Ocimene reduced paw edema and arthritis in rats, lowering NF-κB, caspase-1, ASC, IL-1β, IL-18 and PGE-2 via TLR4/NLRP3/GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis.
